references.label: Five top lanes
references.description: Five rollover lanes that light their corresponding bumpers for 10 points.

references.label: Numbered standups
references.description: Numbered targets that light matching outlanes and raise saucer values in pairs.

references.label: Center saucers
references.description: Two center scoring holes that eject toward the opposite lower flipper.

references.label: Pop bumpers
references.description: Five bumpers whose value rises from 1 to 10 after matching top-lane progress.

references.label: Lower lanes
references.description: Four- or six-outlane lower layout, depending on the installed playfield version.
